items.detail: ★ 原文重點：「我們已經收到您的檔案，請妥善保管下列資訊：漫遊碼：932715、有效期限：2026-10-09 12:27:15、成功檔案：1 個。」列印步驟：①打開漫遊程式輸入漫遊碼開始下載 ②選份數／單雙面等條件 ③付款取件。　【為什麼這封標紅，而且是今天唯一一封紅的】因為它是今天窗口內唯一一件「時間一到就無法挽回」的事。其他信最壞的後果是你少知道一件事、少參加一場活動；這一封最壞的後果是你上傳的那個檔案直接作廢，要重新回電腦前上傳一次。成本不大，但是純粹浪費。　【為什麼現在排進今天】今天 Notion 行程是空的，只有倒垃圾等級的家事。期限是週五中午，看起來還有兩天，但這種「去校內某台機器做一件兩分鐘的事」的任務，典型失敗模式就是每天都覺得還有時間、然後週五早上在趕課。今天進校園時順路做掉是成本最低的時點。　【做之前先確認一件事】先想一下這份檔案是什麼、還需不需要印——如果是已經不需要的舊檔，就不用為了「不浪費」而特地跑一趟，直接讓它過期也是合理決定。

items.title: 🟡 兵役：115 年「分階段接受常備兵役軍事訓練」（暑假分兩年當兵）10/15 上午 10 時開放申請，11/15 下午 5 時截止
items.kind: 需要動作：這週先決定要不要申請（不是現在送件），10/15 開放後再上系統；建議今天只做一件事——把 10/15 開放日和 11/15 截止日補進行事曆
items.detail: ★ 原文重點：依徵兵規則第 26 條第 2 項，就讀專科以上學校男子得志願申請「連續二年暑假分階段接受常備兵役軍事訓練」。申請對象：83 至 93 年次就讀國內外（含港澳及大陸地區）專科以上學校男子，可於 116、117 兩年暑假分階段完訓。申請期間：115/10/15（四）10:00 起至 115/11/15（日）17:00 止。入營梯次三選一（原文列 115/6/8、115/7/6、115/7/30 三個日期），申請人數逾員額時由內政部役政司於 115/11/16（一）10:00 公開抽籤。申請系統：內政部役政司全球資訊網 dca.moi.gov.tw 首頁／主題單元 APP 內的「分階段接受常備兵役訓練系統」。生輔組公告：assistance-osa.ncku.edu.tw/p/406-1051-306092,r3592.php　【為什麼這封是今天最重要的「非急件」】它沒有今天要做的動作，但它是今天這批信裡唯一一件會改變你未來兩個暑假怎麼過的事。分階段受訓的意思是把 1 個月的軍事訓練拆成兩年暑假各做一半——對在學生來說，差別是「畢業後整段空檔被佔掉」還是「兩個暑假各讓一半」。這是一個要自己算的取捨，不是一封公告。　【要特別注意的兩個陷阱】①「申請人數逾員額時抽籤」——所以不是先搶先贏，但也不是一定錄取，不能把暑假計畫押在一定抽到上面。②原文列的三個入營梯次日期寫的是 115 年（2026 年）6–7 月，與「116、117 年暑假受訓」的敘述對不上，可能是原文誤植。真的要申請，10/15 開放後務必在系統上以系統顯示的梯次日期為準，不要照這封信記。　【建議的決策節奏】今天不用決定，但這週內花 20 分鐘想清楚「116 年暑假你原本打算做什麼（實習？專題？考試？）」，因為那就是你實際要放棄的東西。

items.title: 🟡 工程數學一次上架一大包：Ch.1 & 2 講義與課程影片、Problem Set #1 與 #2（附詳解）、課本 2023 版缺漏章節補檔
items.kind: 需要動作：今天先登入 Moodle 把檔案全部下載存好（約 5 分鐘），本週內做 Problem Set #1；沒有繳交期限，所以這是「自己對自己設期限」的那種作業
items.detail: ★ 原文清單（第一則 09:43）：Introduction to this course／Handouts & Course Videos（Ch. 1 & 2）／Problem Set #1 with detailed solution／Sec. 1.2 Prob. 10／課本 2023 版缺漏的 INTEGRATING FACTORS 一節＋奇數題答案／課本 2023 版缺漏的 REDUCTION OF ORDER 一節＋奇數題答案／Sum of sinusoidal functions at the same frequency／Ch. 2 章末習題（O'Neil 8e SI ed.）／Problem Set #2 with detailed solution。第二則（09:44）補充：解 Sec. 1.2 Prob. 10 會用到 nth roots（z^(1/n)）與 rational power（z^(m/n)）的概念，老師指出課本作者 O'Neil 把這個基礎寫在 2023 版 Sec. 19.5，讀完那節再回來做這題會輕鬆很多。討論區：moodle.ncku.edu.tw/mod/forum/discuss.php?d=480918　【為什麼這封值得特別停一下】因為老師第二則信其實是在幫你省時間：他看到有人卡在 Sec. 1.2 Prob. 10，直接點名「你缺的不是這一題的解法，是 Sec. 19.5 的複數開根號基礎」。這種訊息的價值在於它把「這題好難」翻譯成「我有一塊前置知識沒補」——這是整個工數最常見的卡點來源。　【建議的做法順序】①先讀 Sec. 19.5（複數的 n 次方根與有理次方），②再做 Sec. 1.2 Prob. 10，③然後才動 Problem Set #1。倒過來做會浪費一個晚上。　【一個容易忽略的點】老師把「2023 版課本缺漏章節」補出來了（INTEGRATING FACTORS、REDUCTION OF ORDER）——這兩節是一階 ODE 和二階降階的核心工具，如果你手上是 2023 版，缺的就正好是最常考的兩節。今天下載時務必確認這兩個檔有存到。

items.detail: ★ 原文重點：成大將於 2026/10/19（一）舉辦【成大－東京科大聯合研究日】（NCKU–Science Tokyo Joint Research Day）。由成大半導體學院、東京科大 WOW Alliance 與國研院台灣半導體研究中心（TSRI）合作，專家學者主講半導體先進封裝、矽光子、熱管理及 3D 整合等前瞻領域，透過研究成果分享促進台日雙方研究人員與產業夥伴合作。半導體場次為 Session B。　【為什麼把這封從「活動通知」裡挑出來】因為這四個題目（先進封裝／矽光子／熱管理／3D 整合）正好是今天股市區那條主線的技術底層——你會在下面看到台光電、世芯、緯穎這些 CCL／ASIC／伺服器股又漲，而它們漲的原因就是這幾項技術的量產需求。一邊是課堂題目、一邊是盤面，這場活動是少見的能把兩邊接起來的場合。對化工背景的人，「熱管理」（thermal management）這一塊特別接近你的本科——液冷、界面材料、熱傳都在這裡。　【實務提醒】這類台日聯合研究日通常現場有東京科大教授在，如果有出國唸研究所的念頭，這是零成本接觸的場合；議程若有 poster 或交流時段，比聽演講本身更有用。

items.en: Ukraine Launches Over 650 Drones at the Moscow Region as Strikes Hit the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Plant
items.zh: 無人機戰爭規模再上一階：單夜 650 架攻向莫斯科州，核電廠也被打到——這是今天國際新聞裡最值得盯的一條，因為它把「戰爭」和「核安全」綁在一起了
items.summary: Ukraine launched more than 650 drones at the Moscow region overnight, killing two people and injuring nine, in one of the largest single-night drone barrages of the war. Russia separately reported that Ukrainian drones struck the Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant in southeastern Ukraine, killing one worker, while Moscow claimed there was no threat to nuclear safety. The exchange marks a further escalation in long-range strike volume on both sides, and keeps the plant, Europe's largest, at the centre of safety concerns that the IAEA has repeatedly warned about since 2022.

items.en: Trump Moves U.S. Bombers Out of RAF Fairford After Intelligence on an Iranian Drone Plot
items.zh: 美國把轟炸機從英國基地撤走，理由是情報顯示伊朗革命衛隊計畫無人機襲擊——注意這是「在盟國本土」防無人機，不是在中東
items.summary: President Trump announced the relocation of U.S. bombers from Royal Air Force Fairford in the United Kingdom, citing security threats. U.S. and UK officials confirmed the move followed intelligence about a potential Iranian drone attack ordered by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps. The decision is notable because it treats a NATO home base, not a Middle Eastern forward position, as exposed to drone risk. It follows a pattern across 2026 of cheap one-way drones forcing expensive repositioning of high-value aircraft, a cost asymmetry that now shapes basing decisions in Europe.

items.en: Saudi-Led Coalition Retakes Towns Near Bab el-Mandeb as Houthis Strike Saudi Airports
items.zh: 葉門戰線推進到紅海咽喉：聯軍奪回 Dhubab、Bab、Hadeid 三鎮，青年運動反擊沙烏地兩座機場——這條直接關係到台灣進口能源的海運保費
items.summary: Saudi-led coalition forces recaptured the towns of Dhubab, Bab and Hadeid near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait from Iran-aligned Houthi forces, extending gains made after the Red Sea port of Mocha was taken days earlier. Houthi forces struck back at Saudi airports in Jazan and Najran, injuring three people with limited damage reported. Bab el-Mandeb is the chokepoint linking the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden, so control of its shoreline feeds directly into shipping insurance rates on the Asia-Europe route and into energy import costs for Taiwan.

items.en: Nearly 2,000 French Schools Close as Staffing Protests Escalate and a Teenager Loses a Hand
items.zh: 法國校園抗議升級：近 2,000 所學校停課、兩週內約 6,000 人被逮捕，一名 15 歲少年疑因震撼彈失去左手
items.summary: Nearly 2,000 schools closed across France during protests over staffing shortages and deteriorating facility conditions. A 15-year-old boy lost his left hand in an incident that authorities suggest involved a stun grenade, and roughly 6,000 arrests have been made since the protests began two weeks ago. The dispute began over teacher vacancies and building maintenance, but the injury has shifted public argument onto policing of minors. It is the largest sustained education protest in France in years and has no settlement framework in place yet.

items.en: Quebec Elects a Separatist Minority Government Pledging an Independence Referendum
items.zh: 魁北克變天：主張獨立的魁人政團以 28% 得票拿下少數政府，承諾辦獨立公投——這是北美政治地圖的實質變動，不是地方選舉
items.summary: Parti Quebecois leader Paul St-Pierre Plamondon won a minority government with about 28 percent of the vote and pledged to hold a referendum on Quebec independence. A minority mandate means the party must assemble support from other blocs to legislate, so a referendum is a stated intention rather than a scheduled event. Quebec last voted on independence in 1995, when the sovereignty option lost by roughly one percentage point. Canadian federal markets and the Canadian dollar treat renewed referendum talk as a medium-term risk rather than an immediate one.

items.en: OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and Google All Decline to Guarantee AI Agent Safety Under Oath
items.zh: ★ 今天科技區最值得讀的一條：四家 AI 公司在紐約市議會被要求「宣誓保證」AI 代理會遵守安全規範，四家全部拒絕——而拒絕的理由本身比拒絕更重要
items.summary: At a New York City Council hearing on October 6, representatives from OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and Google were asked by Speaker Julie Menin to guarantee under oath that their AI agents would always follow safety guidelines. OpenAI's Morgan Dwyer said it is not possible to commit that any technology is without risk. Anthropic's Logan Graham said the science of doing this is fundamentally hard and unsettled. Google's Alice Friend said promising perfection is impossible for any product. Menin replied that lawmakers wanted accountability and transparency, not perfection.

items.en: Nvidia and AMD Hit All-Time Highs as Marvell Jumps About 8 Percent
items.zh: AI 半導體三雄同日新高／大漲：NVDA 與 AMD 創歷史新高、MRVL 單日約 +8%，而且是在美債殖利率偏高的環境下漲的
items.summary: U.S. technology shares led indices to record closes on October 6 despite elevated Treasury yields, with all-time highs in Nvidia and AMD. Nvidia closed up about 0.14 percent and AMD rose about 2.80 percent, while Marvell Technology surged roughly 8 percent. Constellation Energy jumped about 13 percent, extending the pattern of power-generation names being repriced as AI data-centre demand grows. On the losing side, Novavax fell about 9 percent and Moderna dropped about 5 percent, leaving the session's strength narrowly concentrated in AI compute and the electricity that feeds it.

items.en: Samsung Opens a Quantum Design Lab in Boston to Expand Its U.S. Research Footprint
items.zh: 三星在波士頓開設量子設計實驗室，把量子研發據點推進美國學研聚落——記憶體大廠開始佈局量子，這條線值得長期追
items.summary: Samsung opened a quantum design laboratory in Boston as part of a wider push to expand its United States research presence, according to a DigiTimes report dated October 5. Boston places the lab inside a dense academic cluster for quantum information science, which matters for hiring and for collaboration with university groups. The move is strategically notable because Samsung's core business is memory and foundry rather than quantum hardware, suggesting the company is positioning for quantum control electronics and cryogenic packaging rather than building a competing qubit platform.

items.en: White Sox and Rays Both Take 2-0 Leads in the ALDS as Three Teams Near the Championship Series
items.zh: MLB 分區系列賽 10/05 戰果：白襪 4:3 守護者、光芒 5:2 洋基，兩隊都 2-0 聽牌；洋基再輸一場就結束了
items.summary: In American League Division Series Game 2 action on October 5, the Chicago White Sox beat the Cleveland Guardians 4-3 and the Tampa Bay Rays beat the New York Yankees 5-2, giving both the White Sox and the Rays 2-0 series leads. The Milwaukee Brewers also lead the San Diego Padres 2-0 in the National League Division Series, putting three teams one win from the championship round. The Los Angeles Dodgers and Atlanta Braves remain tied 1-1, making their series the only one still level.

items.en: Brewers and White Sox Carry Sweep Chances Into Game 3 on October 6
items.zh: 10/06 兩場 Game 3：道奇作客勇士（系列 1-1）、釀酒人作客教士（系列 2-0），釀酒人與白襪都有機會直落三過關
items.summary: The October 6 Division Series schedule put the Los Angeles Dodgers at the Atlanta Braves in National League Game 3 at 6 p.m. ET, followed by the Milwaukee Brewers at the San Diego Padres at 9:30 p.m. ET. Both the Brewers and the Chicago White Sox entered the day able to clinch their series with a win, which would complete three-game sweeps and give them extra rest before the championship series. For the Yankees, Padres and Guardians, Game 3 was an elimination game in all but name.

items.en: The 2026 Postseason Bracket Leaves Only One Division Series Still Tied
items.zh: 本屆季後賽結構已經收斂：四組分區系列賽只剩道奇－勇士還是 1-1，其餘三組都呈 2-0，冠軍賽對手可能很快就明朗
items.summary: With three of the four Division Series standing at 2-0 after October 5, the 2026 postseason bracket has compressed unusually fast. Sweeps shorten the path for the leading teams and hand them rotation advantages going into the League Championship Series, because a team that finishes in three games can set its pitching order rather than burn a bullpen. The Dodgers and Braves at 1-1 are the only series guaranteed to need at least four games, making that matchup the one that still decides the shape of the National League bracket.

items.en: A Randomized Trial Finds Salsa Dancing Eases Depressive Symptoms in Young Adults
items.zh: 隨機對照試驗：跳騷莎舞能減輕年輕成人的憂鬱症狀——對學生族群的實務意義是「結構化的社交型運動」可能比單純運動更有效
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial reported on October 6 found that salsa dancing eased depressive symptoms in young adults. The design matters more than the headline: randomization is what separates this from the many correlational studies linking exercise and mood. For students, the practical reading is that the intervention combined three ingredients at once, namely physical activity, learning a skill, and scheduled social contact, so it is not simply exercise relabelled. Sample size and journal were not stated in the summary, so the effect size should be treated as provisional until the full paper is checked.

items.en: Neuroimaging Suggests the Brain May Use a Shared Code for Gender Across Faces, Bodies and Objects
items.zh: 神經影像研究：大腦判斷「性別」時，對臉、身體、甚至物件似乎用同一套編碼——這對社會認知與刻板印象研究是基礎性的發現
items.summary: A neuroimaging study reported on October 6 suggests the brain may use a shared representational code for gender across faces, bodies and even objects. If replicated, that would mean gender categorisation is not a face-specific process but a general dimension the visual system applies broadly, which bears directly on how stereotypes attach to non-human stimuli such as products and tools. The report did not specify the journal, imaging modality or participant numbers, so the claim is best filed as a lead to verify rather than a settled finding.

items.en: Self-Talk During Psilocybin Therapy May Predict Outcomes in Alcohol Treatment
items.zh: 小型研究：病人在裸蓋菇素治療過程中的「自我對話」內容，可能預測酒精成癮治療的成效——方法學上有趣，但樣本小
items.summary: A study reported on October 5 found that the content of patients' self-talk during psilocybin-assisted therapy may indicate positive outcomes in alcohol treatment. The report described it explicitly as a small study, which limits how far the result can be generalised. The methodological interest is that it treats in-session language as a measurable predictor rather than relying only on before-and-after symptom scores, an approach that could apply well beyond psychedelic therapy. Journal and exact sample size were not given, so treat the direction as suggestive only.

items.en: Xanadu and GlobalFoundries Sign a Multi-Year Deal to Manufacture Photonic Quantum Components at 300mm Scale
items.zh: ★ 量子產業今天最實質的一條：Xanadu 與 GlobalFoundries 簽多年合約，在紐約 Malta 的 300mm 廠量產單光子偵測器與超低損耗氮化矽光路——量子從實驗室走向半導體產線
items.summary: Announced on October 6, Xanadu and GlobalFoundries entered a multi-year strategic partnership to develop and manufacture photonic quantum computing components. The work focuses on industrialising superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors and ultra-low-loss silicon nitride photonics, produced at GlobalFoundries' 300mm facility in Malta, New York. CEO Christian Weedbrook framed it as providing the precision-manufactured infrastructure needed to move quantum technology from research into commercial-scale data centres. No timelines, production targets or financial figures were disclosed, so the significance is the manufacturing route rather than any announced volume.

items.en: AI Safety Oversight Moves to City Level as New York Questions Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini Makers Directly
items.zh: AI 治理往下移了一層：紐約市議會直接把 Anthropic（Claude）、OpenAI（ChatGPT）、Google（Gemini）、Meta 叫到面前質詢 agent 安全，不再只有聯邦與歐盟在管
items.summary: The October 6 New York City Council hearing is structurally significant because it put the makers of Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini in front of a municipal legislature rather than a federal or European regulator. Companies were asked to guarantee their AI agents follow safety guidelines and all declined to give absolute assurances, citing unsettled science and the impossibility of risk-free technology. City-level questioning expands the number of venues that can demand disclosure about agent behaviour, which raises compliance surface area for any firm deploying autonomous agents across jurisdictions.

items.en: Commercial Quantum Computing Solutions Are Projected to Compound at Roughly 33 Percent Annually
items.zh: 量子商業化市場報告：年複合成長率約 33.2%，IBM、Google、Microsoft、IonQ 推動雲端與混合架構採用——高成長率要配著「基期很小」一起讀
items.summary: A global market report issued October 6 projects commercial quantum computing solutions growing at a compound annual rate of about 33.2 percent, driven by IBM, Google, Microsoft and IonQ accelerating cloud and hybrid adoption. A 33 percent compound rate sounds dramatic but should be read alongside the small absolute base, since most current revenue is research access and pilot contracts rather than production workloads. The useful signal is the delivery model: quantum is being sold as cloud capacity attached to classical pipelines, not as standalone machines customers buy.

items.en: Ado Announces a Second Cover Album, Adoの歌ってみたアルバム その２, for December 23
items.zh: ★ 清單內最新一條（昨天 10/6 公布）：Ado 第二張翻唱專輯 12/23 發售，約 10 首、跨 VOCALOID／J-POP／西洋，限定版附壓克力立牌 ¥5,500、通常版 ¥3,300
items.summary: On October 6, Ado announced her second cover album, titled Ado no Utattemita Album Sono 2, for release on December 23, 2026. The limited edition with an acrylic stand and sticker is priced at 5,500 yen and the standard CD-only edition at 3,300 yen. The roughly ten-track set spans VOCALOID, J-pop and Western music, with confirmed selections including a 2014 VOCALOID piece, a 2002 J-pop song she recorded as a pre-debut label assignment, and a 1991 metal classic she performed at Summer Sonic 2026. Remaining tracks will be announced later.

items.en: YOASOBI's Asia Dome and Stadium Tour Gets Its Title, 超惑星, With Key Visual and Merchandise Revealed
items.zh: YOASOBI 亞洲 10 城巨蛋／體育場巡演定名【超惑星】，主視覺與部分周邊解禁；台北大巨蛋場次 2027/1/9–10（日本 5 城＋亞洲 5 城）
items.summary: The YOASOBI Asia 10-City Dome and Stadium Tour 2026-2027 has been given the title Chowakusei, covering five domestic Japanese cities and five Asian cities, with the key visual and part of the merchandise line revealed by Billboard Japan. It is billed as the first Asia-wide dome and stadium tour by a Japanese act at this scale. The Taipei Dome dates stand at January 9 and 10, 2027, which is the pair of dates fans in Taiwan need for scheduling, since dome-scale shows in Taipei rarely add extra nights once announced.

items.en: King Gnu's CEN+RAL Tour 2026 Pre-Sale Opens October 13, With Taipei Set for June 6-7
items.zh: ★ 台灣場重點：King Gnu CEN+RAL Tour 2026 台北 6/6–6/7、香港 5/29–30、曼谷 5/23、上海 6/13–14、首爾 6/20–21；日本場先行預售 10/13 18:00 開賣
items.summary: King Gnu's CEN+RAL Tour 2026 runs from February to June 2026 with ten Japanese cities playing two consecutive nights each, followed by Asian dates in Bangkok on May 23, Hong Kong on May 29-30, Taipei on June 6-7, Shanghai on June 13-14 and Seoul on June 20-21. Japanese arena standing tickets are 16,000 yen and reserved seats 14,000 yen, with the first pre-sale window opening October 13 at 18:00 JST and closing October 26, and a second window running November 13 to 24. Overseas pricing remains to be announced.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's POPS Holds No.1 as the SHADOWS Arena Tour Stays Japan-Only
items.zh: 延續追蹤：Mrs. GREEN APPLE《POPS》首週 63.8 萬張（Oricon 64.6 萬）登頂、連兩張破 50 萬；但「SHADOWS」巡演 13 城 28 場目前仍全在日本，沒有台北場
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE's sixth album POPS, released September 30, 2026, debuted at No.1 on Billboard Japan's album sales chart with 638,000 copies and on Oricon's weekly chart with 646,000, their second consecutive album above 500,000 first-week units. The 16-track set pairs seven previously released songs with nine new ones. The accompanying SHADOWS arena tour covers 13 cities and 28 shows, all inside Japan, so there is still no Taipei date for Taiwan-based fans to plan around and any overseas leg would need a separate announcement.

market.asOf: 台股＝前一交易日 2026/10/06（週二）13:30 收盤；美股＝2026/10/06（週二）收盤。★ 今天是週三，台股 09:00 開盤、美股昨夜已收。
market.highlight: ★★★ 今天開盤前只要記住三件事：**①台股 49,822.55（+110.51 點、+0.22%），距離五萬點只剩 178 點，但成交金額從週一的 1.15 兆縮到 9,759 億（縮約 15%）——價繼續漲、量退回來了，這是週一「價量俱揚」之後的第一個雜音。②美股三大指數同日創新高（S&P 7,818.93／那斯達克 27,599.89／道瓊 51,521.28），NVDA 與 AMD 雙雙歷史新高，但 NVDA 只漲 0.14%——領漲棒子交到 AMD（+2.80%）和 MRVL（約 +8%）手上。③你清單內今天只有 4 檔漲 ≥5%（緯穎 +6.51、世芯-KY +5.82、台光電 +5.18、MRVL 約 +8%），比週一的 7 檔收斂；真正的警訊在另一邊——聯發科 2454 單日 −4.74%，是權值股裡最大的拖累。**
market.note: ★ 今天三條主線：　①【台股：只差 178 點，但量先軟了】加權指數 49,822.55，+110.51 點（+0.22%），成交金額 9,759.35 億元，相對週一的 1 兆 1,508 億縮約 15%。盤中一度上衝 49,968 點（距五萬僅 32 點）後拉回，尾盤靠權值股拉抬才守住紅盤。解讀上要小心兩件事：第一，週一晨報才確認「價量俱揚」，才過一天量就退回 9,700 億級，表示那波爆量帶有事件性而非趨勢性；第二，指數還在漲但是靠少數權值股撐，廣度在縮。五萬點是一個心理關卡，愈靠近愈容易出現「一次衝過去再洗一次」的走法，不要把「只差 178 點」讀成「必定過」。　②【美股：三大齊創新高，但領漲者換人】S&P 500 收 7,818.93（+44.98、+0.58%）、那斯達克 27,599.89（+122.58、+0.45%）、道瓊 51,521.28（+253.38、+0.49%），三者同日創收盤新高，而且是在美債殖利率偏高的環境下創的。真正的訊息在個股：NVDA 創歷史新高但只漲 0.14%（等於是停在那裡創新高），AMD +2.80% 同樣新高，MRVL 約 +8%，Constellation Energy（CEG）+13%。這組合說的是資金從「AI 第一棒（GPU）」往「AI 第二棒（ASIC／網通／電力）」移動——CEG 漲 13% 和 MRVL 漲 8% 是同一個故事的兩端：算力擴張到了開始缺電的階段。反向看，Novavax −9%、Moderna −5%，生技繼續失血。　③【清單內：族群從 7 檔收斂到 4 檔，而且出現一檔權值股重挫】你 75 檔觀察清單今天 ≥5% 的只有 4 檔：緯穎 6669 +6.51%、世芯-KY 3661 +5.82%、台光電 2383 +5.18%，以及美股的 MRVL 約 +8%。和週一比（7 檔漲停族群）明顯收斂，但注意：收斂的方向是「同一條線上的少數幾檔繼續走」，而不是族群瓦解——緯穎（AI server）、世芯（ASIC）、台光電（高速 CCL）、MRVL（資料中心網通）四檔其實是同一條 AI 伺服器供應鏈的不同層。真正要記的反而是另一邊：**聯發科 2454 單日 −4.74%（收 4,920 元）**，加上聯電 2303 −3.28%。同一天、同一個「半導體」標籤，伺服器材料與 ASIC 在漲、手機晶片與成熟製程在跌——這是這兩天盤面最清楚的一條分界線，比指數漲幾點重要得多。
